## Purpose

Describe the problem and the change. Link the relevant issue or paper when useful.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran the relevant tests or demos listed in the repository
- [ ] Documented API, numerical, or data-format changes (if any)

## Notes

List checks you could not run, known limitations, and any follow-up needed. Keep scientific results with the corresponding research project.
